name: Evangelism Ministry
summary: Our evangelism ministry, carrying the gospel to prisons, communities and the nations.
description: The Evangelism Ministry of ECM is inspired by the call of Jesus to go into all the world and preach the gospel. Through street outreach, visitation and personal witnessing, we invite people to know Jesus Christ the Way, the Truth and the Life.
It is the outreach and missions arm of ECM, driven by the Great Commission in Mark 16:15: Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
The ministry organises evangelism, community outreaches and our annual Go Ye Train to Akuse Prisons, where we share the gospel, pray with inmates and provide practical support.

name: Children's Ministry
summary: Helping our children know and love Jesus through fun, age appropriate Bible teaching.
description: Our Children's Ministry provides a safe, joyful place for children to learn about God through Bible stories, songs, crafts and games.
We partner with parents to raise children who love Jesus and grow in wisdom and stature.

name: Youth Ministry
summary: Raising a generation of young people on fire for God and ready to lead.
description: The Youth Ministry gathers teenagers and young adults for worship, Bible study, mentorship and fellowship.
We help young people build a strong foundation in Christ and discover their purpose.

name: Choir and Music Ministry
summary: Leading the church into the presence of God through song.
description: Our choir and music team lead the congregation in joyful, Spirit filled worship every service.
If you sing or play an instrument and love to worship, we would love to have you.

name: Media Ministry
summary: Sharing the message of ECM online through livestreams, video and design.
description: The Media Ministry runs our livestreams, sound, projection, photography and social media.
Join us if you have skills in cameras, sound, design or social media, or simply a willingness to learn.

name: Technical Team
summary: Keeping our sound, lighting and equipment running so every service flows smoothly.
description: The Technical Team looks after the sound, lighting, instruments and equipment that support worship at ECM, both in the auditorium and on our livestream.
If you have technical skills or are willing to learn, the team would love to serve with you.

name: Prayer Ministry
summary: Standing in the gap for the church, our families and the nation.
description: The Prayer Ministry leads the church in intercession. We pray for the needs of members, the work of the ministry and the nations, believing that prayer changes things.
Everyone is welcome to join us at the Friday Prayer Meeting.

name: Welfare Ministry
summary: Caring for one another in times of joy and in times of need.
description: The Welfare Ministry makes sure no member walks alone. We celebrate with those who celebrate, support those who are going through difficult seasons and visit the sick and bereaved.
Speak to the Welfare team if you or someone you know needs support.

name: Ushering Team
summary: Welcoming everyone who walks through our doors and keeping every service orderly.
description: The Ushering Team is the first smile many people see at ECM. Ushers welcome members and visitors, help everyone find a seat and keep the service running in order.
If you love serving people and making them feel at home, the Ushering Team would love to have you.

name: Finance Team
summary: Faithful stewardship of the gifts and resources God provides.
description: The Finance Team oversees the tithes, offerings and gifts entrusted to the church with integrity and transparency, so that every cedi serves the work of the gospel.
If you would like to make a donation, tap Make a donation to reach the Finance Team on WhatsApp, or see the Give page for Mobile Money and bank details.
